ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity dark-grey pixels to 30% high-intensity white-to-cream pixels, with the latter concentrated strictly at the distal lateral extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Disjointed white patches on lateral lobes; left lobe shows vertically oriented mottling and distinct streaks extending from the trailing edge; right lobe features a more consolidated, roughly triangular white region on the outer third.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetric, well-defined U-shaped central notch with an approximate angle of 105 degrees and moderate pixel-depth relative to the transverse axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Primarily smooth trailing edge with low-frequency, low-amplitude undulations; terminal points exhibit high-frequency jaggedness corresponding to epibiont clusters.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading and outer margins, sweeping upward and outward to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast, raised pixel groups (barnacles) localized along the extreme lateral tips and leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous fine, vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) distributed across the dark medial and central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal lobe tips; significant parallel linear rake-mark scarring visible across the dark pigmented regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical white pigmentation pattern between lobes, with the left lobe exhibiting more broken, mottled high-intensity pixels compared to the more solid patch on the right lobe.
